def solution():
    # Define variables
    dividend_2017 = 0.22
    high_growth_rate = 0.12
    stable_growth_rate = 0.06
    required_return = 0.09
    high_growth_years = 4

    # Calculate the dividend in year 4 and the expected dividend in year 5
    dividend_year_4 = dividend_2017 * (1 + high_growth_rate) ** high_growth_years
    dividend_year_5 = dividend_year_4 * (1 + stable_growth_rate)

    # Calculate terminal value at the end of year 4 using the Gordon Growth Model
    terminal_value = dividend_year_5 / (required_return - stable_growth_rate)

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(terminal_value, 3)
